industries.title: Highways & Railways
industries.description: We deliver automation systems and monitoring solutions for seamless highway and railway operations, ensuring safety, efficiency for long-term infrastructure management.

industries.title: Highways
industries.description: Highways are wide roads that connect cities, towns, and villages for fast and safe transportation.

industries.title: Chemical and Agrochemical
industries.description: We enable precise chemical process control, monitoring, and storage automation, improving safety, productivity, and environmental compliance in the chemical and agrochemical industries.

industries.title: Power plant
industries.description: We provide automation solutions for power generation, distribution, and monitoring systems, ensuring reliable operations, optimized resource usage, and high energy efficiency.

industries.title: Pulp and Paper
industries.description: We deliver smart automation for paper mills, improving control, reducing waste, enhancing quality.

industries.title: Cement industries
industries.description: Our advanced automation systems enhance cement production by streamlining processes, reducing energy consumption, and improving the quality and consistency of cement across the manufacturing cycle.

industries.title: Sugar industries
industries.description: We deliver automation solutions for sugar processing plants, optimizing production cycles, reducing waste, and enhancing the quality and scalability of refined sugar production.

services.title: PCC and MCC Control Panel
services.description: A PCC (Power Control Center) panel distributes and controls electrical power in industrial and commercial applications, while an MCC (Motor Control Center) panel manages multiple motors, ensuring efficient operation, monitoring, and protection.

services.title: VFD Control Panel
services.description: VFD control panels are mainly used to control the speed of the electric motors and also of the feed pumps that are used in various industrial facilities. Every motor has varying frequency and voltage.

services.title: APFC Control Panel
services.description: Automatic Power factor correction panel is fully automatic in operation and can achieve desired power factor under fluctuating load conditions

services.title: Power Distribution Panel
services.description: This type of panel distributes and controls power supply to multiple circuits, ensuring safe and efficient electricity distribution in buildings or industrial setups.

services.title: Roadside Panel Cabinets
services.description: We manufacture all types of Roadside panel cabinets like Toll Lane Controller (TLC), Automatic traffic counter & classifier (ATCC), Video incident detection system (VIDS), Variable Message Sign (VMS), PTZ Camera, Vehicle actuated speed display (VASD) etc.

services.title: Energy Metering System
services.description: An Energy Metering System is used to measure, monitor, and analyse electrical energy consumption in industrial, commercial, and residential applications. It helps in energy management, cost optimization, and power quality analysis.

services.title: PLC/HMI/SCADA
services.description: PLC, HMI and SCADA are the main components of the industrial automation. Together, they form a complete industrial automation system, improving efficiency, monitoring, and control in various industries like manufacturing, power, and infrastructure.

services.title: Field Instrumentation
services.description: The diligent demands of process operations require to have reliable, accurate devices that gives the measurements to meet the user’s requirements.

services.title: RFID Based Tracing & Tracking Solutions
services.description: The ability to track and trace complete information at item level in an efficient and trustworthy manner is becoming more and more important for companies,

services.title: System Integration
services.description: System integration is essential to reap the benefits of big data, IoT, and digital transformation. However, with all your different data silos and specialized systems, integration is not an easy business.

services.title: Alarm Management
services.description: Implementation of a successful alarm management program can seem complex in the beginning. Knowing where and how to start can be a daunting experience.

services.title: Sensors, IOT Solutions
services.description: Sensors and IoT work together to create smart systems by detecting physical changes and transmitting real-time data over the internet. Sensors collect data, while IoT enables connectivity, remote monitoring, and intelligent decision-making.

advantages.title: Innovative Engineering
advantages.description: We seamlessly integrate cutting-edge technologies with industry best practices to deliver solutions that exceed expectations.

advantages.title: Expert Team
advantages.description: Our team of highly skilled professionals specializes in mechanics, electricity, automation, instrumentation, and information systems.

advantages.title: Proven Experience
advantages.description: With over 3000+ panels, 2000+ poles, and 8000+ brackets successfully delivered, our track record speaks for itself.

advantages.title: Quality and Reliability
advantages.description: Partnering with globally recognized brands such as Siemens, ABB, Allen Bradley, Schneider, Omron, Eaton & PROCON, we ensure the highest standards of quality & performance.
